```{r}
# libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(table1)
library(reshape2)
```

```{r}
df = read.csv("../Data/metadata_prepped_261001.csv")
df = df[df$time==1, ]

df$gender = plyr::mapvalues(df$gender, 
          from=c(1, 2, NaN, 3), 
          to=c("Male","Female", "Other", "Other"))

df$final_group <- dplyr::case_when(
  df$is_patient == 0 ~ "HC",
  df$is_patient == 1 & df$HiMo_subject == 1 ~ "HiMo_CBP",
  df$is_patient == 1 & df$HiMo_subject == 0 ~ "LoMo_CBP"
)

df$passes_2mm_criterion = plyr::mapvalues(df$passes_2mm_criterion,
          from = c(0, 1), to = c("No", "Yes"))

T1 <- table1(
  ~ gender + 
    age + 
    backpain_length +
    bpi_intensity_t1 +
    spon_pain_rating_mean +
    odi_t1 +
    negative_affect_t1 +
    promis_sleep_t1 +
    n_spike_regs_sponpain +
    mean_fd +
    max_abs_disp +
    passes_2mm_criterion | final_group, 
  data = df,
  render.continuous = c(.="Median [Min, Max]"),
  overall = FALSE
)

T1
```


```{r}
library(rvest)

t1_df <- T1 %>% 
  as.character() %>% 
  read_html() %>% 
  html_table(fill = TRUE) %>% 
  .[[1]]

colnames(t1_df)[1] <- "Variable"

vars_continuous <- c("age", "backpain_length", "bpi_intensity_t1", "spon_pain_rating_mean",
                      "odi_t1", "negative_affect_t1", "promis_sleep_t1",
                      "n_spike_regs_sponpain", "mean_fd", "max_abs_disp")

vars_categorical <- c("gender", "passes_2mm_criterion")

p_continuous <- sapply(vars_continuous, function(v) {
  kruskal.test(df[[v]] ~ df$final_group)$p.value
})

p_categorical <- sapply(vars_categorical, function(v) {
  chisq.test(table(df[[v]], df$final_group))$p.value
})

p_all <- c(p_continuous, p_categorical)
p_all_formatted <- ifelse(p_all < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(p_all, format = "f", digits = 3))
names(p_all_formatted) <- names(p_all)

t1_df$`P-value` <- ""

for (v in names(p_all_formatted)) {
  row_idx <- which(t1_df[[1]] == v)
  if (length(row_idx) == 1) {
    t1_df$`P-value`[row_idx] <- p_all_formatted[v]
  } else {
    warning(glue::glue("Could not find a unique matching row for '{v}' — check t1_df manually"))
  }
}

t1_df

t1_df <- t1_df[, c("Variable", "HC(N=51)", "LoMo_CBP(N=120)", "HiMo_CBP(N=31)", "P-value")]
write.csv(t1_df, "../Data/Table1_261001.csv")
```

```{r}
sig_vars <- names(p_all[p_all < 0.05])
sig_continuous  <- intersect(sig_vars, vars_continuous)
sig_categorical <- intersect(sig_vars, vars_categorical)

# --- One generic pairwise helper for both continuous (Wilcoxon) and categorical (Fisher) ---
pairwise_generic <- function(var, df, test_type = c("wilcox", "fisher"), p.adjust.method = "bonferroni") {
  test_type <- match.arg(test_type)
  x <- df[[var]]
  group <- df$final_group
  
  if (test_type == "wilcox") {
    test <- pairwise.wilcox.test(x, group, p.adjust.method = p.adjust.method, exact = FALSE)
    comparison <- as.vector(outer(rownames(test$p.value), colnames(test$p.value), paste, sep = " vs "))
    p_value <- as.vector(test$p.value)
  } else {
    pairs <- combn(unique(group), 2, simplify = FALSE)
    p_value <- sapply(pairs, function(pair) {
      sub_idx <- group %in% pair
      fisher.test(table(x[sub_idx], group[sub_idx]))$p.value
    })
    p_value <- p.adjust(p_value, method = p.adjust.method)
    comparison <- sapply(pairs, paste, collapse = " vs ")
  }
  
  data.frame(variable = var, comparison = comparison, p_value = p_value)
}

posthoc_table <- rbind(
  do.call(rbind, lapply(sig_continuous, pairwise_generic, df = df, test_type = "wilcox")),
  do.call(rbind, lapply(sig_categorical, pairwise_generic, df = df, test_type = "fisher"))
)
posthoc_table <- na.omit(posthoc_table)

# --- Approximate p-value buckets ---
format_p_approx <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    p < 0.0001 ~ "<0.0001",
    p < 0.001  ~ "<0.001",
    p < 0.01   ~ "<0.01",
    p < 0.05   ~ "<0.05",
    TRUE       ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
  )
}
posthoc_table$p_value_approx <- format_p_approx(posthoc_table$p_value)

# --- Standardize comparison direction + reshape wide ---
desired_order <- c("HC vs LoMo_CBP", "HC vs HiMo_CBP", "LoMo_CBP vs HiMo_CBP")

posthoc_table$comparison <- sapply(strsplit(posthoc_table$comparison, " vs "), function(parts) {
  matched <- intersect(c(paste(parts, collapse = " vs "), paste(rev(parts), collapse = " vs ")), desired_order)
  if (length(matched)) matched[1] else paste(parts, collapse = " vs ")
})

library(tidyr); library(dplyr)

posthoc_wide <- posthoc_table %>%
  select(variable, comparison, p_value_approx) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = comparison, values_from = p_value_approx) %>%
  select(variable, all_of(desired_order))

write.csv(posthoc_wide, "../Data/Table1_posthoc_comparisons_261001.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
df = read.csv("../Data/240508_metadata_prepped.csv")
df = df[df$time == 1, ]
df[df$is_patient == 0, ]$backpain_length = 0

cols = c("motion_outliers", "n_spike_regs_sponpain", "promis_sleep_t1", "negative_affect_t1", "odi_t1", 
         "bpi_intensity_t1", "backpain_length", "ethnicity", "weight",  "age", "gender", "is_patient")

df_num = na.omit(df[cols])  # remove Nan & subset interesting cols
df_num <- apply(df_num, 2, function(x) as.numeric(x))

cormat <- round(cor(df_num),2) # get correlations
melted_cormat <- melt(cormat, na.rm = TRUE)

gg_heat <- ggplot(data = melted_cormat, aes(Var2, Var1, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white",
    midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1,1), 
    space = "Lab",
    name="Pearson\nCorrelation") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, size = 12, hjust = 1)) +
  coord_fixed() + 
geom_text(aes(Var2, Var1, label = value), color = "black", size = 4)
```
